L7_ADJUDICATION_RULE.rule: NORMATIVE. An OPAQUE_HIGH_ENTROPY finding at op_id V-R2.L7, normalized_schema_path deployments[*].meta.githubRepo, is classified EXPECTED_PROVIDER_IDENTIFIER if and only if ALL of A-G hold for EVERY finding of that deployments page. Otherwise the certified STOP (STOP_SECRET_BEARING_FIELD_RETURNED with the v1.0.6 safe diagnostic) is unchanged.

conditions.A: detector_id = OPAQUE_HIGH_ENTROPY, and every finding of the page sits at exactly deployments[*].meta.githubRepo (a finding anywhere else, including the same value at deployments[*].name, STOPs the page).
conditions.B: The value satisfies the v1.0.8 certified GitHub repository-name grammar (GITHUB_REPOSITORY_NAME_RE, reused, not redefined).
conditions.C: The page was requested for a team + project enumerated in THIS run (existing preconditions: complete scope inventory, project in it, RNA-1 antigravity exclusion).
conditions.D: That SAME team + project has a V-R2.S2 projects[*].link.repo that the SAME executor's G-R5 inventory witness adjudicated (the binding is written only by a successful finalizeRepositoryWitness()).
conditions.E: The value is BYTE-FOR-BYTE equal (JavaScript ===) to that project's witnessed link.repo.
conditions.F: The value trips no detector other than OPAQUE_HIGH_ENTROPY (checked on the value itself, and every located finding must be OPAQUE_HIGH_ENTROPY).
conditions.G: The equality is derived only from the already-witnessed identifier: L7 performs no read, has no request input of its own, and the binding cannot be set by any other path.

L7_ADJUDICATION_RULE.no_normalization: No case folding, trim, Unicode normalization, URL parsing, .git stripping, owner stripping, slash normalization, fuzzy or substring match. Each is a tested STOP.
L7_ADJUDICATION_RULE.not_global: Not authorized: every deployments[*].meta.githubRepo, every grammar-valid name, every name matching GitHub syntax, every 40-character value. V-R4.DEPLOYMENTS (the same meta field) remains F_IMMEDIATE_ONLY_BEFORE_MUTATION and is refused in this phase.
L7_ADJUDICATION_RULE.grammar_role: Defense in depth only; the trust source is the same-run G-R5 witness via the same-project binding.

SAME_PROJECT_BINDING.mechanism: Executor state witnessedLinkRepoByProject: key = [teamId, projectId], value = the witnessed link.repo. The teamId is the executor's own V-R2.S2 request parameter for the deferred page (pendingScope), never reparsed from evidence text. The L7 lookup key is the executor's own V-R2.L7 request parameters.
SAME_PROJECT_BINDING.deployment_membership_basis: REQUEST_SCOPE. A deployments page belongs to the project it was requested for (GET /v6/deployments?projectId=<id>&teamId=<id>, built by the executor). The certified L7 projection carries no per-deployment projectId, and none is added.
SAME_PROJECT_BINDING.cross_project: Project A's witnessed value presented on project B's page STOPs, whether or not B has its own adjudication. The same projectId under another team/scope STOPs.
SAME_PROJECT_BINDING.conflict: Two different witnessed values for one team + project STOP (STOP_WITNESS_UNKNOWN).

SAME_RUN_BINDING.mechanism: The binding is an instance field of SafeReadExecutor, created empty with every executor (one executor = one governed run), with no setter: it is written only by finalizeRepositoryWitness() after a successful witness verdict.
refused: a failed witness verdict (zero match, multiple match, name/owner/id mismatch)

EVIDENCE_ADJUDICATION.record_form: A V-R2.L7 record carries AT MOST ONE scanner_adjudications entry, with exactly these keys: normalized_schema_path (deployments[*].meta.githubRepo), team_id, project_id, detector_id (OPAQUE_HIGH_ENTROPY: the raw detector finding), classification (EXPECTED_PROVIDER_IDENTIFIER: the final explanation status), basis (SAME_RUN_SAME_PROJECT_EXACT_EQUALITY_TO_WITNESSED_LINK_REPO: the adjudication basis), source_op_id (V-R2.S2) and source_normalized_schema_path (projects[*].link.repo): the source, source_basis (SAME_RUN_AUTHENTICATED_REPOSITORY_INVENTORY_ID_MATCH) and same_run_witness_op_id (G-R5): the same-run witness, exact_equality (true), owner_corroboration.
EVIDENCE_ADJUDICATION.no_provider_value: The entry carries only identifiers already present in the record's own endpoint and fixed tokens; the repository name is never duplicated into it.
EVIDENCE_ADJUDICATION.envelope_binding: assertEnvelopeConforms refuses an L7 entry whose team_id/project_id are not the record's own request scope (operation.endpoint prefix), any second entry, any other key or value, and any L7-form entry on another op.
EVIDENCE_ADJUDICATION.EC1: The EC-1 re-scan explains an L7 finding only if the record carries that entry for its own request scope, the finding is OPAQUE_HIGH_ENTROPY at projection.deployments[].meta.githubRepo (decoded) or inside that exact quoted "githubRepo": value (serialized), the value is grammar-valid and trips no other detector, AND the value is bound to that team + project both by the caller's lookup (in-run: the executor's same-run binding) and by a V-R2.S2 record of the SAME file set that adjudicated it. The standalone pre-commit CLI keeps the bundle binding. v1.0.7/v1.0.8 EC-1 rules for V-R2.S2 are unchanged; no existing evidence-scan detector or rule is weakened.
